item.title: DMK-Congress alliance back on track: Chidambaram meets Stalin, final deal expected today
item.description: The Congress had been demanding a share in the government in Tamil Nadu and additional seats, leading to disputes with the DMK. Last Saturday, talks were held with the DMK seat-sharing committee. Tamil Nadu Congress Committee President Selvaperunthagai had stated that the DMK agreed to give a Rajya Sabha seat and the talks went smoothly at that time.

item.title: Gold and silver prices rise today amid Iran-US conflict; silver up by a smaller extent
item.description: Whenever there is tension in the air and uncertainty rises, the prices of both precious metals, gold and silver get a shot in the arm. item.title: Iran claims control of Strait of Hormuz as Trump orders US Navy to escort oil tankers
item.description: Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps has claimed control over the Strait of Hormuz, one of the world’s most critical energy shipping routes. The announcement came as tensions rise after US Israeli strikes on Iran and counterattacks across West Asia. In response, US President Donald Trump ordered the US Navy to escort oil tankers through the strait if required to ensure the global flow of energy.
